name: Gaki, Jikki-Nikki
body:
JIKKI-NIKKI-GAKI CR 2

XP 600
NE Medium undead (gaki, shapechanger)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 16 (3d8+3); fast healing 1
Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +3
Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +4 (1d6+1), 2 claws +4 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks rake (bite, 1d6+1)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 15, Con -, Int 7, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Toughness, Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +6, Stealth +7, Perception +5
Languages Common
SQ change shape (Tiny beetle or fly; vermin shape II), feast of flesh

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Feast of Flesh (Ex)

As a full-round action, a jikki-nikki-gaki can spend 1 round feasting on the corpse of a Small or larger creature, regaining 2d6 hit points for a Small creature, 4d6 for a Medium creature, or 6d6 for a Large or larger creature. Once it has feasted on a creature, the remains decay and cannot be used for another feast.

Rake (Ex)

Against a helpless or grappled foe, a jikki-nikki-gaki may make a bite attack.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or gang (2-4)
Treasure incidental

This blue-skinned humanoid creature has a yawning, fanged mouth, and long clawed fingers. Its flesh bears gruesome scars and gaping wounds revealing swollen purple flesh within.

Spirits of greed, avarice, and gluttony, jikki nikki-gaki retain their basically humanoid form but their flesh is rotten and repulsive, pallid and flaking. Some are bloated and corpulent as a mark of their eternal gluttony, while others are emaciated as through forever starving with a hunger that cannot be satisfied.

A jikki-nikki-gaki is an ambusher. Although not very intelligent, it uses cunning to set up advantageous situations.

When encountered in groups, jikki-nikki-gaki surround their enemies, using pack tactics.
